name: The Wine-Dark Sea
description: A branching Greek drama world. A shared ship visits the Wine-Dark Harbor, Athens Harbor and Piraeus. Fixed roads lead through the Attic places where welcome becomes a growing poem.
tone: Concrete Greek domestic and civic life: bread, work, desire, grief, argument, irreverence, and hospitality. Dialogue expresses committed actions. A tragic ending is never required.

continuity.policy: Account choices are saved quest commitments. Only the chosen account activates its residents, evidence, and outward route. A return route stays open. Inquiry hooks record a question; they do not replay an ancient catastrophe or silently change the live era.

coverage.status: Forty-three works have authored scenes across the Greek chapters. Frogs and the witnessed reading flow are the final source work in progress.

The messenger’s dead, Darius’s future Plataea warning and Xerxes’s actual return have separate records. Atossa’s private household consolation and the civic reckoning are original alternatives to the final public lament. The fixed road joins the Trojan Walls and the Court at Susa. Its eastern end enters the named historical Salamis account.

greek-ares-hill.text: A stone court stands above Athens. Each case names its speaker, time and claim.

greek-heracles-theban-house.name: Heracles's House · Earlier Thebes

greek-heracles-theban-house.persona: A named earlier account from Euripides's Heracles. Megara and the boys belong to its first scene. The messenger's report opens the aftermath. The family's care and both friends' journeys follow their saved acts.

greek-heracles-athens-road.name: The Athens Road · Heracles Account

greek-heracles-athens-guest-room.name: Theseus's Guest Room · Heracles Account
greek-heracles-athens-guest-room.text: A receiving table and two chairs wait in this earlier Athenian room. The road returns to Heracles's house. A help tablet can be delivered before the friends arrive.
greek-heracles-athens-guest-room.persona: Theseus's guest room in the earlier Euripides account. A placed tablet proves its own delivery. Heracles and Theseus reach the room through their own agreed journeys. This is separate from the present Agora.

greek-danaid-refuge-court.name: Argive Refuge Court

greek-vii-crag-camp.name: The Crag Camp

choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays out the cloth and oil at the prepared grave. The brother receives a burial despite the standing prohibition.

choices.label: Hear the tale of Heracles’s children
choices.text: The keeper opens a separate tale after Heracles’s death, under Demophon, son of Theseus. Iolaus and the children sought shelter here. Eurystheus’s herald claimed them and used force. Demophon upheld the altar’s protection. Vale hears the claim beside the present shrine.

choices.subject: greek-marathon-keeper
choices.label: Hear the daughter’s own answer
choices.text: In the tale, an oracle demanded a noble maiden’s life. Demophon refused to compel a household. Heracles’s daughter offered herself for her siblings and rejected a lottery. The keeper gives her reasons their full place, then names the life the city’s safety cost. Vale listens.

choices.label: Hear the claim against the captive

It remembers Megara, the three sons, Amphitryon's care and the two friends' completed journey. The traveler tells how they remained beside Heracles in the guest room. Dione hears the chosen duty beside the bread.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} brings the remembrance tablet to Dione's present table. The account is named: Euripides's earlier Heracles. Dione hears the chosen duty beside the bread.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Accept Dione’s introduction to the Argive sanctuary
choices.text: Dione gives Vale Melia’s introduction. The road from the Wine-Dark Harbor runs through the Argolid Crossroads to a living shore sanctuary. Melia tells the older Danaid account there; its ancient speakers keep their own time. The present guests choose the care they accept.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Hear Nera’s terms of shelter
choices.text: Nera tells Vale what she asks of the present hosts: water, food and a room she can choose. She asks that a wool-wreathed branch and filled jug be set beside her at the altar. Her answer concerns her own shelter.
choices.textTemplate: Nera tells {actor} what she asks of the present hosts: water, food and a room she can choose. She asks that a wool-wreathed branch and filled jug be set beside her at the altar. Her answer concerns her own shelter.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-melia
choices.label: Hear the Danaids’ older plea
choices.text: Melia names the older generation in Aeschylus’s Suppliant Women. Danaus brought his daughters from Egypt to the shore of Argos as they fled forced marriage to the sons of Aegyptus. The Danaid chorus asked the gods and Pelasgus for protection, holding wool-wreathed branches. Melia then turns to Nera’s present request for water and shelter.
choices.textTemplate: Melia names the older generation in Aeschylus’s Suppliant Women. Danaus brought his daughters from Egypt to the shore of Argos as they fled forced marriage to the sons of Aegyptus. The Danaid chorus asked the gods and Pelasgus for protection, holding wool-wreathed branches. Melia then turns to Nera’s present request for water and shelter.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Set water and the branch beside Nera
choices.text: Vale sets the filled jug and wool-wreathed branch beside Nera at the present altar. Nera names what she hopes to choose: a household room or the common lodging that Melia keeps ready. Her own decision will follow the hosts’ offer.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the filled jug and wool-wreathed branch beside Nera at the present altar. Nera names what she hopes to choose: a household room or the common lodging that Melia keeps ready. Her own decision will follow the hosts’ offer.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-melia
choices.label: Hear the vote and Melia’s offer of lodging
choices.text: Melia keeps the older speakers clear for Vale. Pelasgus placed the danger before the Argives. Danaus returned to report their raised hands and their resolve to protect the women from seizure, with a duty on the city’s people to help. In the present court, Melia offers household rooms and common lodging. She sets out her own written pledge and a basket of bread for Nera.
choices.textTemplate: Melia keeps the older speakers clear for {actor}. Pelasgus placed the danger before the Argives. Danaus returned to report their raised hands and their resolve to protect the women from seizure, with a duty on the city’s people to help. In the present court, Melia offers household rooms and common lodging. She sets out her own written pledge and a basket of bread for Nera.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Bring Melia’s pledge and bread to Nera
choices.text: Vale carries Melia’s own pledge and provision basket back to the present sanctuary and places them beside Nera. Nera reads the offer. The bread is here; the walk to the room she chooses still lies ahead.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries Melia’s own pledge and provision basket back to the present sanctuary and places them beside Nera. Nera reads the offer. The bread is here; the walk to the room she chooses still lies ahead.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-melia
choices.label: Hear Pelasgus answer the herald
choices.text: Melia tells Vale the next part of the older account. The Egyptian herald demanded the Danaids and threatened to drag them to the ship. Pelasgus confronted him and upheld the Argive resolve against forced surrender. He then offered public lodgings and rooms of his own, asking the women to choose. Danaus returned with an Argive escort. The play leaves their future open. Melia asks the present hosts to keep their own promise to Nera.
choices.textTemplate: Melia tells {actor} the next part of the older account. The Egyptian herald demanded the Danaids and threatened to drag them to the ship. Pelasgus confronted him and upheld the Argive resolve against forced surrender. He then offered public lodgings and rooms of his own, asking the women to choose. Danaus returned with an Argive escort. The play leaves their future open. Melia asks the present hosts to keep their own promise to Nera.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Ask Nera about the household room
choices.text: Nera tells Vale that she chooses the household room opening from Melia’s refuge court. This is her own present answer. She asks to walk there with company and with the prepared bread.
choices.textTemplate: Nera tells {actor} that she chooses the household room opening from Melia’s refuge court. This is her own present answer. She asks to walk there with company and with the prepared bread.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Ask Nera about the common lodging
choices.text: Nera tells Vale that she chooses the common lodging opening from Melia’s refuge court. This is her own present answer. She asks to walk there with company and with the prepared bread.
choices.textTemplate: Nera tells {actor} that she chooses the common lodging opening from Melia’s refuge court. This is her own present answer. She asks to walk there with company and with the prepared bread.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Agree to walk with Nera to her chosen lodging
choices.text: Nera agrees to walk with a traveler from Vale’s company from the present sanctuary to the refuge court. She will wait for company before setting out. The pledge and prepared bread are here, ready to be carried along the path. Her arrival and the delivery of the basket will have their own record.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Set the bread inside Nera’s chosen household door
choices.text: Vale reaches Nera at the refuge court and sets the carried basket inside her chosen household door. Melia sets its bread ready within. Nera signs Melia’s pledge before Vale: “I reached the court. I chose the household room, and the bread reached me.” Her own present arrival can be told to Dione.

choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Set the bread inside Nera’s chosen common lodging
choices.text: Vale reaches Nera at the refuge court and carries the basket through the gate of her chosen common lodging. The basket is set beside her. Nera signs Melia’s pledge before Vale: “I reached the court. I chose the common lodging, and the bread reached me.” Her own present arrival can be told to Dione.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} reaches Nera at the refuge court and carries the basket through the gate of her chosen common lodging. The basket is set beside her. choices.subject: greek-danaid-nera
choices.label: Witness Nera receive the household lodging
choices.text: Vale finds Nera at the refuge court with the provisions in her own hands. Melia opens the chosen household door and sets bread ready within. Nera signs Melia’s pledge before Vale: “I reached the court. I chose the household room, and the bread reached me.” Her present arrival and actual basket can be told to Dione.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Read Nera’s own answer to Dione
choices.text: Vale places Melia’s pledge beside Dione’s bread and reads Nera’s signed answer. Dione hears that Nera reached the present refuge court, chose the household room and received the carried bread. Melia’s older Danaid account keeps its own generation.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Read Nera’s own answer to Dione

choices.textTemplate: {actor} places Melia’s pledge beside Dione’s bread and reads Nera’s signed answer. Dione hears that Nera reached the present refuge court, chose the common lodging and received the carried bread. Melia’s older Danaid account keeps its own generation.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Hear the Trachis account
choices.text: Dione offers Vale an earlier household account. Deianira, Iole, Lichas and Hyllus live in this named telling. The Theban table keeps its own time.
choices.textTemplate: Dione offers {actor} an earlier household account. Deianira, Iole, Lichas and Hyllus live in this named telling. The Theban table keeps its own time.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-iole
choices.label: Hear Iole in a new telling
choices.text: The messenger names Iole and corrects Lichas. In this game adaptation, Iole tells Vale she wants a safe place to rest. The source gives her silence.
choices.textTemplate: The messenger names Iole and corrects Lichas. In this game adaptation, Iole tells {actor} she wants a safe place to rest. The source gives her silence.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-iole
choices.label: Sit beside Iole in silence
choices.text: The messenger names Iole and corrects Lichas. Vale sits beside Iole without asking her to speak, as in the source account.
choices.textTemplate: The messenger names Iole and corrects Lichas. {actor} sits beside Iole without asking her to speak, as in the source account.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-iole
choices.label: Set a meal for Iole
choices.text: Vale sets the meal beside Iole. The invitation belongs to her; her silence remains her choice.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the meal beside Iole. The invitation belongs to her; her silence remains her choice.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-deianira
choices.label: Choose an earlier warning
choices.text: Deianira and Vale enter an alternate telling in which the wool is tested before the parcel leaves. The source account discovers the danger after dispatch.
choices.textTemplate: Deianira and {actor} enter an alternate telling in which the wool is tested before the parcel leaves. The source account discovers the danger after dispatch.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-deianira
choices.label: Follow the source account

choices.textTemplate: Deianira names the source-shaped telling: the robe is sent before the wool reveals its danger. A later recovery becomes a marked alternate telling.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-deianira
choices.label: Place the wool in the sun
choices.text: In this alternate telling, Vale places the treated wool in sunlight before the journey. Deianira sees it break down and doubts the gift.
choices.textTemplate: In this alternate telling, {actor} places the treated wool in sunlight before the journey. Deianira sees it break down and doubts the gift.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-hyllus
choices.label: See the wool after dispatch

choices.textTemplate: After Lichas sets out, {actor} places the treated wool in sunlight. In the source account Deianira discovers its harm too late; Hyllus hears the warning.

choices.textTemplate: Lichas agrees to travel with {actor} to Canae. {actor} carries the garments and casket. The plain garment is the chosen gift.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-lichas
choices.label: Ask Lichas to carry the treated robe

choices.textTemplate: Lichas agrees to travel with {actor} to Canae. {actor} carries the garments and casket. The treated robe is the chosen gift.

choices.textTemplate: Lichas agrees to the road to Canae. {actor} can accompany him while carrying the casket and garments, one step at a time.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-lichas
choices.label: Meet Heracles at Canae

choices.textTemplate: Lichas has reached Canae with {actor}. Heracles stands by the sacrificial ground in this named account.

choices.subject: greek-trachis-lichas
choices.label: Present the plain gift

choices.textTemplate: At Canae {actor} sets the plain cloth beside Heracles. Lichas and {actor} present the altered gift, before any treated garment is delivered.

choices.label: Recover the treated parcel

choices.text: Vale sets down the treated robe at Canae. In the source-shaped account, Heracles receives the robe. Lichas dies in his suffering. The Nurse later reports Deianira’s death; Hyllus later explains her belief. Vale holds the casket as the account turns toward Oeta.

choices.label: Hear Cassandra before the doors close

choices.textTemplate: Cassandra speaks within the earlier homecoming. She names the house’s old violence and foretells her own death and Agamemnon’s. The chorus hears her struggle to be understood. Her prophecy remains her testimony.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the cup beside Cassandra within the recalled homecoming and keeps the words she chose to give.

choices.subject: greek-clytemnestra-aeschylus
choices.label: Hear the opened doors
choices.text: The earlier song reaches the opened doors: Agamemnon and Cassandra are dead. Clytemnestra claims the killings and names Iphigenia. Aegisthus claims the plot and recalls Thyestes. choices.label: Receive the witness at refuge
choices.text: The housekeeper has reached refuge with Vale. The carried record is placed beside her. She gives her name and accepts shelter.
choices.textTemplate: The housekeeper has reached refuge with {actor}. The carried record is placed beside her. She gives her name and accepts shelter.

choices.label: Hear this account’s recognition
choices.text: Electra considers the lock of hair and footprints. Orestes then shows the cloth she wove. She recognizes her brother in Aeschylus’s account. The tablet keeps these signs apart from the palace signet and the farmhouse scar.
choices.textTemplate: Electra considers the lock of hair and footprints. Orestes then shows the cloth she wove. She recognizes her brother in Aeschylus’s account. The tablet keeps these signs apart from the palace signet and the farmhouse scar.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the local signs beside the household tablet. The witness names the recognition in this source.

choices.text: Hermione tells the source ending. Apollo reveals that he saved Helen and made her divine. Those are the god’s commands in the play; each person’s game consent is recorded separately.

choices.subject: greek-iphigenia-tauris
choices.label: Hear Iphigenia’s Tauris letter
choices.text: Iphigenia names the Tauris telling in which Artemis saved her at Aulis. She reads her letter aloud so its words can survive a shipwreck. Pylades immediately gives the source letter to Orestes. Their recognition belongs to this account; another saved Aulis fate remains a separate telling.

choices.subject: greek-iphigenia-tauris
choices.label: Place the letter copy beside its speaker

choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the letter copy beside Iphigenia. She confirms its words and keeps Pylades’s original delivery within the source song.

choices.subject: greek-iphigenia-tauris
choices.label: Hear the family’s further signs
choices.text: Orestes supplies remembered family details and Iphigenia accepts him. He recounts an equal-vote trial: some Furies accepted it and others pursued him. Apollo sent him for Artemis’s image. This Euripidean continuation keeps its own frame beside Aeschylus’s completed settlement.
choices.textTemplate: Orestes supplies remembered family details and Iphigenia accepts him. He recounts an equal-vote trial: some Furies accepted it and others pursued him. Apollo sent him for Artemis’s image. This Euripidean continuation keeps its own frame beside Aeschylus’s completed settlement.

choices.subject: greek-iphigenia-tauris
choices.label: Set the cloth beside the childhood account
choices.text: Vale sets the local cloth beside the letter. Iphigenia names the childhood signs in her account; the cloth serves the present telling.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the local cloth beside the letter. Iphigenia names the childhood signs in her account; the cloth serves the present telling.

choices.subject: greek-thoas
choices.label: Hear the rite, the sea and Athena
choices.text: Thoas recounts the source ending. The cleansing deception leads to escape with the image; the sea drives the ship back. Athena stops his pursuit and commands the captive women’s return. She assigns the image to Halai and Iphigenia to Brauron. Thoas accepts her command. The local rite copy remains here for the game’s own choices.
choices.textTemplate: Thoas recounts the source ending. The cleansing deception leads to escape with the image; the sea drives the ship back. Athena stops his pursuit and commands the captive women’s return. She assigns the image to Halai and Iphigenia to Brauron. Thoas accepts her command. The local rite copy remains here for the game’s own choices.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the water and local image at the shore for the named account and the keepers’ reply.

choices.textTemplate: Thoas agrees to a new game pact for safe passage and a changed rite. {actor} records this separate consent.

choices.textTemplate: The captive women agree to the new game pact and name their own return as its condition. {actor} records this separate consent.

choices.subject: greek-iphigenia-tauris
choices.label: Ask Iphigenia for assent

choices.textTemplate: Iphigenia chooses to remain in the game alternative and work with the women on the new rite. {actor} records this separate consent.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the shore record. The source record keeps the sea’s reversal, Athena’s intervention, the women’s return and the two Attic destinations.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-demos

choices.text: Demos approves Demosthenes and Nicias as named food keepers and agrees that the public tally will stay in the kitchen.
choices.textTemplate: Demos approves Demosthenes and Nicias as named food keepers and agrees that the public tally will stay in the kitchen.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-demosthenes
choices.label: Hear Demosthenes: keeper demosthenes
choices.text: Demosthenes accepts the keeper’s duty under Demos’s public food tally.
choices.textTemplate: Demosthenes accepts the keeper’s duty under Demos’s public food tally.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-nicias
choices.label: Hear Nicias: keeper nicias
choices.text: Nicias accepts the second keeper’s duty and the public count of the food.
choices.textTemplate: Nicias accepts the second keeper’s duty and the public count of the food.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-demosthenes
choices.label: Lodge the public food tally with the agreed keepers
choices.text: Vale places the tally in the kitchen. Demosthenes receives it under Demos’s terms and Nicias’s separate pledge.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the tally in the kitchen. Demosthenes receives it under Demos’s terms and Nicias’s separate pledge.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-demosthenes
choices.label: Record the opened stores
choices.text: The named keepers acknowledge the public tally and their duties. This new coda follows Demos’s renewal and the shared feast.
choices.textTemplate: The named keepers acknowledge the public tally and their duties. This new coda follows Demos’s renewal and the shared feast.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-agoracritus
choices.label: Hear Agoracritus: private favour
choices.text: Agoracritus offers the household serving dish as a voyage gift in return for praise. He states the requested favour openly in the account.
choices.textTemplate: Agoracritus offers the household serving dish as a voyage gift in return for praise. He states the requested favour openly in the account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-agoracritus
choices.label: Accept the real voyage gift and record its price
choices.text: Vale carries the serving dish offered by Agoracritus. The account records the gift and the praise the steward asked in return.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the serving dish offered by Agoracritus. The account records the gift and the praise the steward asked in return.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-knights-demos
choices.label: Hear Demos: signed account
choices.text: Demos signs the stewardship account. It keeps the kitchen evidence, ring transfer, renewal, Truces and the chosen later terms in event order.
choices.textTemplate: Demos signs the stewardship account. It keeps the kitchen evidence, ring transfer, renewal, Truces and the chosen later terms in event order.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Bring Knights’s signed account to Dione
choices.text: Vale lays the signed signed stewardship account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the comic household of Demos, the named recipients and the duties still open.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed stewardship account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the comic household of Demos, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-philocleon
choices.label: Hear Philocleon: father terms
choices.text: Philocleon reports his confinement and accepts his son’s compromise of a household hearing.
choices.textTemplate: Philocleon reports his confinement and accepts his son’s compromise of a household hearing.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-bdelycleon
choices.label: Hear Bdelycleon: son terms
choices.text: Bdelycleon names the hearing’s two voting pots and asks for a jury token before the dog trial.
choices.textTemplate: Bdelycleon names the hearing’s two voting pots and asks for a jury token before the dog trial.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Set the jury token and both voting pots
choices.text: Vale sets the token and the two separate pots in the trial yard. Xanthias receives the hearing’s tools under father and son’s terms.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the token and the two separate pots in the trial yard. Xanthias receives the hearing’s tools under father and son’s terms.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-labes
choices.label: Bring the cheese plate before Labes
choices.text: Vale sets the cheese plate before Labes. The dog sniffs it and circles the two pots as Xanthias keeps the court’s account.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the cheese plate before Labes. The dog sniffs it and circles the two pots as Xanthias keeps the court’s account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Hear Xanthias of the juror's house: dog testimony
choices.text: Xanthias credits the prosecuting dog of Cydathenaea, Labes’s defence, the puppies, Sosias and the Wasps’ chorus. He separates the charge from the hearing’s method.
choices.textTemplate: Xanthias credits the prosecuting dog of Cydathenaea, Labes’s defence, the puppies, Sosias and the Wasps’ chorus. He separates the charge from the hearing’s method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Choose the misdirection voting method
choices.text: Vale chooses the misdirection method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} chooses the misdirection method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Choose the open voting method
choices.text: Vale chooses the open method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} chooses the open method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Choose the purchased voting method
choices.text: Vale chooses the purchased method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} chooses the purchased method for this dog trial. The verdict awaits the ballot pebble.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Cast the pebble for acquittal under misdirection
choices.text: Vale casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the misdirection method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the misdirection method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Cast the pebble for acquittal under open
choices.text: Vale casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the open method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the open method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Cast the pebble for conviction under open
choices.text: Vale casts the pebble at the conviction pot under the open method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} casts the pebble at the conviction pot under the open method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Cast the pebble for acquittal under purchased
choices.text: Vale casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the purchased method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} casts the pebble at the acquittal pot under the purchased method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Cast the pebble for conviction under purchased
choices.text: Vale casts the pebble at the conviction pot under the purchased method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} casts the pebble at the conviction pot under the purchased method. Xanthias records the verdict separately from the method.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Record the dog trial’s method and verdict
choices.text: Xanthias confirms the cast pebble and the recorded verdict. The hearing’s method keeps its own record beside the answer.
choices.textTemplate: Xanthias confirms the cast pebble and the recorded verdict. The hearing’s method keeps its own record beside the answer.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Hear Xanthias of the juror's house: revel report
choices.text: After the dog trial Xanthias reports Philocleon’s revel and the Dardanian flute-player’s treatment as an attributed account.
choices.textTemplate: After the dog trial Xanthias reports Philocleon’s revel and the Dardanian flute-player’s treatment as an attributed account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-myrtia
choices.label: Hear Myrtia the baker: myrtia claim
choices.text: Myrtia names fourteen knocked-down loaves, ten and four, each worth an obol. She credits Chaerephon as her witness and asks for fourteen obols.
choices.textTemplate: Myrtia names fourteen knocked-down loaves, ten and four, each worth an obol. She credits Chaerephon as her witness and asks for fourteen obols.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-claimant
choices.label: Hear the injured claimant: injury claim
choices.text: The injured claimant names the harm from Philocleon’s revel and asks for a bandage and continuing care.
choices.textTemplate: The injured claimant names the harm from Philocleon’s revel and asks for a bandage and continuing care.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-xanthias
choices.label: Hear Xanthias of the juror's house: closing dance
choices.text: After the complaints Xanthias reports Philocleon’s closing dance and the sons of Carcinus. The dance leaves Myrtia’s and the injured claimant’s duties open.
choices.textTemplate: After the complaints Xanthias reports Philocleon’s closing dance and the sons of Carcinus. The dance leaves Myrtia’s and the injured claimant’s duties open.

choices.subject: greek-jury-house
choices.label: Repair the harm after the tricked acquittal
choices.text: Vale undertakes repair the harm after the tricked acquittal in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes repair the harm after the tricked acquittal in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-jury-house
choices.label: Repair the harm after an open hearing
choices.text: Vale undertakes repair the harm after an open hearing in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes repair the harm after an open hearing in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-jury-house
choices.label: Pay the improper favour to the judge
choices.text: Vale undertakes pay the improper favour to the judge in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes pay the improper favour to the judge in Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-myrtia
choices.label: Pay Myrtia her fourteen-obol purse
choices.text: Vale places the fourteen-obol purse with Myrtia. She counts it and accepts the full price of the fourteen loaves.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the fourteen-obol purse with Myrtia. She counts it and accepts the full price of the fourteen loaves.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-claimant
choices.label: Deliver the bandage for the injured claimant
choices.text: Vale delivers the bandage. The injured claimant accepts it and names the continuing care owed.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the bandage. The injured claimant accepts it and names the continuing care owed.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-myrtia
choices.label: Record the tricked hearing and accepted repair
choices.text: Myrtia acknowledges the counted payment and the claimant’s accepted bandage. The account records trial, revel, complaints, dance, payment and open care duties.
choices.textTemplate: Myrtia acknowledges the counted payment and the claimant’s accepted bandage. The account records trial, revel, complaints, dance, payment and open care duties.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-myrtia
choices.label: Record the open hearing and accepted repair
choices.text: Myrtia acknowledges the counted payment and the claimant’s accepted bandage. The account records trial, revel, complaints, dance, payment and open care duties.
choices.textTemplate: Myrtia acknowledges the counted payment and the claimant’s accepted bandage. The account records trial, revel, complaints, dance, payment and open care duties.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-philocleon
choices.label: Deliver the agreed improper favour to Philocleon
choices.text: Vale delivers the purse to Philocleon as the agreed improper favour. He accepts it; Myrtia’s price remains on her tongue.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the purse to Philocleon as the agreed improper favour. He accepts it; Myrtia’s price remains on her tongue.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-philocleon
choices.label: Record the purchased judge and open claims
choices.text: Philocleon accepts the improper purse. Myrtia’s fourteen-obol claim and the injured claimant’s complaint remain active in the signed account.
choices.textTemplate: Philocleon accepts the improper purse. Myrtia’s fourteen-obol claim and the injured claimant’s complaint remain active in the signed account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wasps-myrtia
choices.label: Hear Myrtia the baker: signed account
choices.text: Myrtia signs the revel-claims account, preserving the trial, revel, claims, closing dance, payment and duties still owed in their order.
choices.textTemplate: Myrtia signs the revel-claims account, preserving the trial, revel, claims, closing dance, payment and duties still owed in their order.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Bring Wasps’s signed account to Dione
choices.text: Vale lays the signed signed revel-claims account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims, the named recipients and the duties still open.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed revel-claims account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of Philocleon’s household court and its revel claims, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-pasias
choices.label: Hear Pasias: pasias claim
choices.text: Pasias states his own debt claim and authorises its tablet for the household hearing.
choices.textTemplate: Pasias states his own debt claim and authorises its tablet for the household hearing.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-amynias
choices.label: Hear Amynias: amynias claim
choices.text: Amynias states his separate debt claim and authorises its tablet beside Pasias’s claim.
choices.textTemplate: Amynias states his separate debt claim and authorises its tablet beside Pasias’s claim.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-phidippides
choices.label: Hear Phidippides: horses
choices.text: Phidippides names his horse expenses while Strepsiades’s household ledger records the debts beneath the bed.
choices.textTemplate: Phidippides names his horse expenses while Strepsiades’s household ledger records the debts beneath the bed.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Lay the two lenders’ claims beside the household ledger
choices.text: Vale lays the ledger and both claim tablets beside the bed. Strepsiades hears each lender’s separate claim and his son’s expenses.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the ledger and both claim tablets beside the bed. Strepsiades hears each lender’s separate claim and his son’s expenses.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-socrates
choices.label: Hear the comic Socrates: school arguments
choices.text: The comic Socrates presents Just and Unjust Discourse as competing stage arguments; the Clouds and the disciples keep their own credited roles.
choices.textTemplate: The comic Socrates presents Just and Unjust Discourse as competing stage arguments; the Clouds and the disciples keep their own credited roles.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-pasias
choices.label: Test the lesson against the claims
choices.text: Vale brings the lesson tablet and both lenders’ claims to the court. Pasias witnesses the attempted argument against the written debts.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} brings the lesson tablet and both lenders’ claims to the court. Pasias witnesses the attempted argument against the written debts.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Hear Strepsiades: father harm
choices.text: Strepsiades reports his first creditor evasions and the later beating by Phidippides. He names the lesson’s cost to his household.
choices.textTemplate: Strepsiades reports his first creditor evasions and the later beating by Phidippides. He names the lesson’s cost to his household.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-phidippides
choices.label: Hear Phidippides: son harm
choices.text: Phidippides answers for the beating and reports his threat against his mother. The threatened harm keeps its reported tense in this account.
choices.textTemplate: Phidippides answers for the beating and reports his threat against his mother. The threatened harm keeps its reported tense in this account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-socrates
choices.label: Record the crooked lesson and the household replies
choices.text: Vale records the tested lesson, the father’s harm and the son’s reply as separate parts of the Thinkery account.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} records the tested lesson, the father’s harm and the son’s reply as separate parts of the Thinkery account.

choices.subject: greek-thinkery
choices.label: Present the false account at a new hearing
choices.text: Vale undertakes present the false account at a new hearing in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes present the false account at a new hearing in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-thinkery
choices.label: Settle the debts and agree family repair
choices.text: Vale undertakes settle the debts and agree family repair in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes settle the debts and agree family repair in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-thinkery
choices.label: Carry the torch to the school door
choices.text: Vale undertakes carry the torch to the school door in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes carry the torch to the school door in the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-pasias
choices.label: Hear Pasias: false decision
choices.text: At the new hearing Pasias records the false account’s favourable decision and the debt it leaves unpaid. The claim remains his own.
choices.textTemplate: At the new hearing Pasias records the false account’s favourable decision and the debt it leaves unpaid. The claim remains his own.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Record the winning evasion and its household cost
choices.text: Strepsiades records the new false decision beside Phidippides’s later use of the same reasoning against the family. The unpaid claims remain written.
choices.textTemplate: Strepsiades records the new false decision beside Phidippides’s later use of the same reasoning against the family. The unpaid claims remain written.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-pasias
choices.label: Place the agreed settlement purse beside both claims
choices.text: Vale places the agreed settlement purse beside both claim tablets. Pasias accepts his stated share of the jointly held sum.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the agreed settlement purse beside both claim tablets. Pasias accepts his stated share of the jointly held sum.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-amynias
choices.label: Hear Amynias: amynias payment
choices.text: Amynias accepts his stated share of the delivered settlement purse and records satisfaction of his separate claim.
choices.textTemplate: Amynias accepts his stated share of the delivered settlement purse and records satisfaction of his separate claim.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Hear Strepsiades: father repair
choices.text: Strepsiades agrees to the recorded repayment and names the household repair he will undertake.
choices.textTemplate: Strepsiades agrees to the recorded repayment and names the household repair he will undertake.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-phidippides
choices.label: Hear Phidippides: son repair
choices.text: Phidippides agrees to stop the household harm and accept the stated repair terms with his father.
choices.textTemplate: Phidippides agrees to stop the household harm and accept the stated repair terms with his father.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Record both lenders’ acceptance and the repair terms
choices.text: Strepsiades receives the two lenders’ recorded acceptance of the delivered purse. Father and son keep their own agreed repair duties.
choices.textTemplate: Strepsiades receives the two lenders’ recorded acceptance of the delivered purse. Father and son keep their own agreed repair duties.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-socrates
choices.label: Carry the torch to the school door
choices.text: Vale carries the torch to the school door in the attack at the end of Aristophanes’s comedy. The changed school awaits its separate witness report.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the torch to the school door in the attack at the end of Aristophanes’s comedy. The changed school awaits its separate witness report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-chaerephon
choices.label: Hear Chaerephon of the Thinkery: attack damage
choices.text: Chaerephon reports Strepsiades’s attack, the school’s fire damage and the disciples’ flight at the close of the comedy. The household debts remain unpaid.
choices.textTemplate: Chaerephon reports Strepsiades’s attack, the school’s fire damage and the disciples’ flight at the close of the comedy. The household debts remain unpaid.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-chaerephon
choices.label: Record the damaged school and unpaid debts
choices.text: Chaerephon confirms the damaged school after the torch was carried to its door. The account keeps both unpaid claims beside the attack report.
choices.textTemplate: Chaerephon confirms the damaged school after the torch was carried to its door. The account keeps both unpaid claims beside the attack report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-clouds-strepsiades
choices.label: Hear Strepsiades: signed account
choices.text: Strepsiades signs the debt-and-school account, naming both claims, the family’s replies and the chosen result with its witness report.
choices.textTemplate: Strepsiades signs the debt-and-school account, naming both claims, the family’s replies and the chosen result with its witness report.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Bring Clouds’s signed account to Dione
choices.text: Vale lays the signed signed debt-and-school account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts, the named recipients and the duties still open.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed debt-and-school account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the Thinkery comedy and Strepsiades’s debts, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Hear Lysistrata: lysistrata vow
choices.text: Lysistrata states her own coalition pledge and the treasury occupation’s purpose. Calonice and Stratyllis keep their credited roles.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata states her own coalition pledge and the treasury occupation’s purpose. Calonice and Stratyllis keep their credited roles.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lampito
choices.label: Hear Lampito: lampito vow
choices.text: Lampito states Sparta’s pledge and the allies’ household needs in her own words.
choices.textTemplate: Lampito states Sparta’s pledge and the allies’ household needs in her own words.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-myrrhine
choices.label: Hear Myrrhine: myrrhine vow
choices.text: Myrrhine chooses her own pledge and reply to Cinesias. Their child remains a person in the reported household scene.
choices.textTemplate: Myrrhine chooses her own pledge and reply to Cinesias. Their child remains a person in the reported household scene.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-cinesias
choices.label: Hear Cinesias: cinesias reply
choices.text: Cinesias names his household need and hears Myrrhine’s chosen answer. Each spouse keeps their own pledge.
choices.textTemplate: Cinesias names his household need and hears Myrrhine’s chosen answer. Each spouse keeps their own pledge.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lampito
choices.label: Bring the cup to the separate coalition vows

choices.textTemplate: {actor} sets the oath cup beside Lampito. The coalition records each woman’s own pledge and Myrrhine’s chosen household answer.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-magistrate
choices.label: Hear the Magistrate: spending account

choices.textTemplate: The Magistrate states the disputed war spending. Lysistrata’s wool argument and the two choruses’ confrontation retain their credited speakers.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the wool and unfinished cloth to the loom. Myrrhine and the traveler weave the treaty cloth and record their work.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the woven cloth to the herald. He receives the coalition’s proposed terms and credits the Athenian and Spartan envoys separately.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes accept the shared peace and feast in the women’s coalition and its comic peace. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.label: Add a lasting council to the peace

choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes add a lasting council to the peace in the women’s coalition and its comic peace. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-acropolis

choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes accept the limited athens-first treaty in the women’s coalition and its comic peace. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.text: Lysistrata approves the chosen treaty text and states the coalition’s handover terms for the treasury key.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata approves the chosen treaty text and states the coalition’s handover terms for the treasury key.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-spartan-herald
choices.label: Hear the Spartan herald: herald reply
choices.text: The Spartan herald accepts the chosen negotiated text for his delegation and states the duties it covers.
choices.textTemplate: The Spartan herald accepts the chosen negotiated text for his delegation and states the duties it covers.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lampito
choices.label: Hear Lampito: lampito reply
choices.text: Lampito authorises an exact account of the chosen terms. Her allies’ dissent stays attached to the limited Athens-first treaty.
choices.textTemplate: Lampito authorises an exact account of the chosen terms. Her allies’ dissent stays attached to the limited Athens-first treaty.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Publish the accepted cloth and prepare the first feast
choices.text: Vale publishes the treaty cloth and prepares the first feast from the delivered occupation basket. Lysistrata receives the recorded replies and credits both cities’ closing singers.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} publishes the treaty cloth and prepares the first feast from the delivered occupation basket. Lysistrata receives the recorded replies and credits both cities’ closing singers.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-magistrate
choices.label: Receive the Magistrate’s authority for the key handover
choices.text: The Magistrate authorises Vale to carry the treasury key under the accepted treaty’s terms.
choices.textTemplate: The Magistrate authorises {actor} to carry the treasury key under the accepted treaty’s terms.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Complete the agreed key handover and feast
choices.text: Lysistrata holds the treasury key under the shared peace. She acknowledges the prepared feast and the two cities’ closing song.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata holds the treasury key under the shared peace. She acknowledges the prepared feast and the two cities’ closing song.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Hear Lysistrata: council pledge
choices.text: Lysistrata names herself and Lampito as the first oversight keepers under both delegations’ accepted council terms.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata names herself and Lampito as the first oversight keepers under both delegations’ accepted council terms.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lampito
choices.label: Hear Lampito: lampito council
choices.text: Lampito accepts her named oversight duty under the agreed lasting council.
choices.textTemplate: Lampito accepts her named oversight duty under the agreed lasting council.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-myrrhine
choices.label: Lodge the key and spending ledger under the council pledge
choices.text: Vale lodges the key and spending ledger at the loom under the two named keepers’ accepted duties. Myrrhine receives the public record.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lodges the key and spending ledger at the loom under the two named keepers’ accepted duties. Myrrhine receives the public record.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-myrrhine
choices.label: Record the council’s first custody and duties
choices.text: Myrrhine confirms the key and spending ledger in the agreed public place. The new council follows the accepted settlement and prepared feast.
choices.textTemplate: Myrrhine confirms the key and spending ledger in the agreed public place. The new council follows the accepted settlement and prepared feast.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Record the limited treaty and the allies’ dissent
choices.text: Lysistrata receives the treasury key under the accepted limited terms. Lampito’s and the excluded allies’ stated questions remain in the peace account.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata receives the treasury key under the accepted limited terms. Lampito’s and the excluded allies’ stated questions remain in the peace account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lampito
choices.label: Hear Lampito: lampito signature
choices.text: Lampito signs the chosen peace account, preserving the allies’ place in the terms and their exact stated dissent.
choices.textTemplate: Lampito signs the chosen peace account, preserving the allies’ place in the terms and their exact stated dissent.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-lysistrata-lysistrata
choices.label: Hear Lysistrata: signed account
choices.text: Lysistrata and Lampito authorise the signed peace account. The delivered cloth, key handover, first feast and remaining duties have their own records.
choices.textTemplate: Lysistrata and Lampito authorise the signed peace account. The delivered cloth, key handover, first feast and remaining duties have their own records.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Bring Lysistrata’s signed account to Dione
choices.text: Vale lays the signed signed peace account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the women’s coalition and its comic peace, the named recipients and the duties still open.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed peace account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of the women’s coalition and its comic peace, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-praxagora
choices.label: Hear Praxagora: planned speech
choices.text: Praxagora states the planned assembly speech and authorises the loaned beard and cloak for the civic vote.
choices.textTemplate: Praxagora states the planned assembly speech and authorises the loaned beard and cloak for the civic vote.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-praxagora
choices.label: Bring the borrowed beard and cloak for the assembly
choices.text: Vale delivers the borrowed beard and cloak for Praxagora’s assembly speech. The vote awaits its own later report.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the borrowed beard and cloak for Praxagora’s assembly speech. The vote awaits its own later report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-blepyrus
choices.label: Hear Blepyrus: assembly vote
choices.text: Blepyrus credits Chremes’s account of the women’s successful assembly vote and Praxagora’s new authority.
choices.textTemplate: Blepyrus credits Chremes’s account of the women’s successful assembly vote and Praxagora’s new authority.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-praxagora
choices.label: Return the borrowed clothing after the vote
choices.text: Vale returns the borrowed beard and cloak to Praxagora after the recorded vote. She receives the two borrowed articles.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} returns the borrowed beard and cloak to Praxagora after the recorded vote. She receives the two borrowed articles.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-contributor
choices.label: Hear the contributing citizen: citizen contribution
choices.text: The contributing citizen names the deposited household goods and credits Sicon and Parmeno for the work of carrying them.
choices.textTemplate: The contributing citizen names the deposited household goods and credits Sicon and Parmeno for the work of carrying them.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-withholder
choices.label: Hear the withholding citizen: citizen withholding
choices.text: The withholding citizen names the purse he keeps apart and the public share he still intends to claim.
choices.textTemplate: The withholding citizen names the purse he keeps apart and the public share he still intends to claim.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-contributor
choices.label: Bring the common pot and count the contribution list
choices.text: Vale brings the common pot and contribution list to the goods yard. The two citizens’ separate deposits and withheld purse enter the count.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} brings the common pot and contribution list to the goods yard. The two citizens’ separate deposits and withheld purse enter the count.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-older-woman
choices.label: Hear the first older woman: older woman law
choices.text: The older woman states the decree’s intimate articles and credits the second and third older women’s demands under the same law.
choices.textTemplate: The older woman states the decree’s intimate articles and credits the second and third older women’s demands under the same law.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-young-man
choices.label: Hear the young man: young man law
choices.text: The young man names the decree’s pressure on his body and bonds. He credits the young woman’s own complaint about its coerced duties.
choices.textTemplate: The young man names the decree’s pressure on his body and bonds. He credits the young woman’s own complaint about its coerced duties.

choices.subject: greek-assembly
choices.label: Publish the whole decree beside the feast
choices.text: Vale undertakes publish the whole decree beside the feast in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes publish the whole decree beside the feast in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-assembly
choices.label: Agree a common table with each adult’s bodily choice
choices.text: Vale undertakes agree a common table with each adult’s bodily choice in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes agree a common table with each adult’s bodily choice in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-assembly
choices.label: Help conceal the purse and take the public share
choices.text: Vale undertakes help conceal the purse and take the public share in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes help conceal the purse and take the public share in Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-praxagora
choices.label: Hear Praxagora: praxagora amendment
choices.text: Praxagora agrees to a revised decree that shares the common table while each adult chooses their own body and bonds.
choices.textTemplate: Praxagora agrees to a revised decree that shares the common table while each adult chooses their own body and bonds.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-older-woman
choices.label: Hear the first older woman: older woman amendment
choices.text: The older woman accepts the revised decree’s shared table and each adult’s bodily choice, after the other affected women’s separately credited replies.
choices.textTemplate: The older woman accepts the revised decree’s shared table and each adult’s bodily choice, after the other affected women’s separately credited replies.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-young-man
choices.label: Hear the young man: young man amendment
choices.text: The young man accepts the revised decree. He carries the young woman’s approved reply that her own body and bonds remain her choice.
choices.textTemplate: The young man accepts the revised decree. He carries the young woman’s approved reply that her own body and bonds remain her choice.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-withholder
choices.label: Hear the withholding citizen: withholder permission
choices.text: The withholding citizen agrees that the traveler may conceal his purse in his covered pot while he claims a public share.
choices.textTemplate: The withholding citizen agrees that the traveler may conceal his purse in his covered pot while he claims a public share.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-withholder
choices.label: Conceal the purse in the withholder’s covered pot
choices.text: Vale places the purse in the withholder’s covered pot. He acknowledges it, while the public contribution list retains the shortfall.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} places the purse in the withholder’s covered pot. He acknowledges it, while the public contribution list retains the shortfall.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-older-woman
choices.label: Carry and publish the decree at the feast threshold
choices.text: Vale carries the decree to the feast threshold and publishes the chosen text before the affected speakers. The older woman receives the paper.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the decree to the feast threshold and publishes the chosen text before the affected speakers. The older woman receives the paper.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-older-woman
choices.label: Prepare and serve the common meal
choices.text: Vale brings the common pot, cooks and serves the first meal with Praxagora’s servant maid. The account credits her work and the herald’s call.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} brings the common pot, cooks and serves the first meal with Praxagora’s servant maid. The account credits her work and the herald’s call.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-young-man
choices.label: Record the whole decree beside the supplied feast
choices.text: The supplied feast follows the full published decree. The young man’s and women’s reports keep its coerced intimate duties and their complaints beside the abundance.
choices.textTemplate: The supplied feast follows the full published decree. The young man’s and women’s reports keep its coerced intimate duties and their complaints beside the abundance.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-young-man
choices.label: Record the accepted amendment and the common table
choices.text: The affected speakers acknowledge the agreed amendment and the supplied meal. Each adult keeps the stated choice over their own body and bonds.
choices.textTemplate: The affected speakers acknowledge the agreed amendment and the supplied meal. Each adult keeps the stated choice over their own body and bonds.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-young-man
choices.label: Take the public share with the concealed shortfall recorded
choices.text: Vale receives a meal from the common pot after helping conceal the withholder’s purse. The contribution list preserves the shortfall and the cooks’ labour.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} receives a meal from the common pot after helping conceal the withholder’s purse. The contribution list preserves the shortfall and the cooks’ labour.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-assemblywomen-praxagora
choices.label: Hear Praxagora: signed account
choices.text: Praxagora signs the feast-and-law account, naming the published law, supplied meal, cooks’ work, withheld goods and the affected speakers’ recorded replies.
choices.textTemplate: Praxagora signs the feast-and-law account, naming the published law, supplied meal, cooks’ work, withheld goods and the affected speakers’ recorded replies.

choices.subject: greek-baker
choices.label: Bring Assemblywomen’s signed account to Dione
choices.text: Vale lays the signed signed feast-and-law account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast, the named recipients and the duties still open.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed feast-and-law account beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of Praxagora’s comic assembly and common feast, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Hear Plutus: plutus at gate
choices.text: Plutus names his blindness and agrees that the traveler may ask to guide him to the healing porch in Chremylus’s comic account.
choices.textTemplate: Plutus names his blindness and agrees that the traveler may ask to guide him to the healing porch in Chremylus’s comic account.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Agree the journey to the healing porch and granary
choices.text: Plutus agrees to travel with Vale from the farm to the healing porch, then to the granary after his cure has its own report.
choices.textTemplate: Plutus agrees to travel with {actor} from the farm to the healing porch, then to the granary after his cure has its own report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Serve Plutus at his healing-porch arrival
choices.text: Vale serves the welcome basket to Plutus after their agreed arrival at the healing door. Plutus acknowledges his supper.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} serves the welcome basket to Plutus after their agreed arrival at the healing door. Plutus acknowledges his supper.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-poverty
choices.label: Hear Poverty: poverty claim
choices.text: Poverty asks who will do the work when wealth changes hands and whose labour will receive a wage.
choices.textTemplate: Poverty asks who will do the work when wealth changes hands and whose labour will receive a wage.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-carion
choices.label: Hear Carion, called Cario in volume 2: household wage
choices.text: Carion names the household’s work and his own wage claim. He credits Blepsidemus and Chremylus’s wife as separate speakers.
choices.textTemplate: Carion names the household’s work and his own wage claim. He credits Blepsidemus and Chremylus’s wife as separate speakers.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Lay the coverlet and offering bowl for Plutus
choices.text: Vale lays the coverlet and offering bowl beside the arrived Plutus after hearing Poverty and the household’s wage claim.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the coverlet and offering bowl beside the arrived Plutus after hearing Poverty and the household’s wage claim.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-carion
choices.label: Hear Carion, called Cario in volume 2: cure report
choices.text: Carion reports the temple cure in full: Asclepius and the snakes restore Plutus’s sight, with Iaso and Panacea in their credited roles.
choices.textTemplate: Carion reports the temple cure in full: Asclepius and the snakes restore Plutus’s sight, with Iaso and Panacea in their credited roles.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Hear Plutus: sight answer
choices.text: Plutus answers Carion’s cure report and names his restored sight. He confirms the agreed onward journey to the distribution granary.
choices.textTemplate: Plutus answers Carion’s cure report and names his restored sight. He confirms the agreed onward journey to the distribution granary.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Record the cure report and Plutus’s own response
choices.text: Vale records Carion’s attributed cure and Plutus’s own answer after preparing his resting place. Plutus’s onward journey now has its agreed next step.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} records Carion’s attributed cure and Plutus’s own answer after preparing his resting place. Plutus’s onward journey now has its agreed next step.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-just-man
choices.label: Hear the just man: just man claim
choices.text: The just man names his earlier loss and changed fortune and agrees to bring his claim to the distribution granary.
choices.textTemplate: The just man names his earlier loss and changed fortune and agrees to bring his claim to the distribution granary.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-carion
choices.label: Hear Carion, called Cario in volume 2: carion journey
choices.text: Carion agrees to bring his wage claim to the granary after the cure report.
choices.textTemplate: Carion agrees to bring his wage claim to the granary after the cure report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-informer
choices.label: Hear the informer: informer claim

choices.textTemplate: The informer states his loss under the new riches and presses his excluded claim before the distribution.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-carion
choices.label: Hear Carion, called Cario in volume 2: closing petitioners

choices.textTemplate: Carion reports Hermes seeking work, Zeus’s priest seeking food and the older woman’s dispute. The household announces a procession to install Wealth at Athena’s temple.

choices.textTemplate: Plutus arrives at the distribution granary under his agreed journey. {actor} records his presence before the first distribution.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes supply the chosen worthy recipient and set out in Chremylus’s comic encounter with Plutus. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.text: Vale undertakes publish the agreed grain and wage distribution in Chremylus’s comic encounter with Plutus. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.
choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes publish the agreed grain and wage distribution in Chremylus’s comic encounter with Plutus. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Keep the grain and wages under the farm’s private terms

choices.textTemplate: {actor} undertakes keep the grain and wages under the farm’s private terms in Chremylus’s comic encounter with Plutus. The chosen work still awaits its deliveries and replies.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the grain basket to the arrived just man. He accepts the chosen worthy share while the informer’s claim stays in the account.

choices.textTemplate: Carion authorises {actor} to carry the vegetable pot as the announced procession sets out. The wider riches remain his credited comic report.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-chremylus

choices.textTemplate: {actor} carries the vegetable pot from the granary to the farm gate. Chremylus records the worthy grain share and the announced procession’s departure with its remaining petitioners.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Hear Plutus: distribution terms
choices.text: Plutus approves the first grain share for the just man and the wage purse for Carion, with Poverty and the informer’s claims retained.
choices.textTemplate: Plutus approves the first grain share for the just man and the wage purse for Carion, with Poverty and the informer’s claims retained.

choices.label: Deliver the agreed grain basket to the just man

choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the agreed basket. The just man accepts it and names the amount in the first-distribution ledger.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-carion
choices.label: Deliver Carion’s wage purse

choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers the wage purse to Carion at the granary. He counts and accepts his wage after the agreed grain delivery.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-plutus
choices.label: Publish the accepted first grain and wage distribution
choices.text: Plutus confirms the named recipients’ grain and wage deliveries and their separate acknowledgements. Poverty and the informer’s remaining claims stay in the public ledger.
choices.textTemplate: Plutus confirms the named recipients’ grain and wage deliveries and their separate acknowledgements. Poverty and the informer’s remaining claims stay in the public ledger.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-wealth-chremylus
choices.label: Hear Chremylus: private farm terms
choices.text: Chremylus agrees to keep the grain and wage purse under his household’s private terms; the petitioners’ own claims stay recorded.
choices.textTemplate: Chremylus agrees to keep the grain and wage purse under his household’s private terms; the petitioners’ own claims stay recorded.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} lodges the grain and wage purse with Chremylus at the farm. He accepts private custody and records the petitioners still waiting.

choices.textTemplate: Chremylus confirms his household’s private grain and wage stores. Carion’s wage claim and the other petitioners’ stated claims remain in the ledger.

choices.textTemplate: Chremylus signs the first-distribution ledger. It names the real baskets and purse, their recipients, the petitioners still waiting and the procession’s recorded state.

choices.subject: greek-baker

choices.textTemplate: {actor} lays the signed signed first-distribution ledger beside Dione’s bread. Dione hears the authorised result of Chremylus’s comic encounter with Plutus, the named recipients and the duties still open.

choices.textTemplate: Mica chooses the words the traveler may carry about the women’s complaint against Euripides. Her wine-skin remains her wine-skin.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-thesmophoria-critylla
choices.label: Hear Critylla: critylla words
choices.text: Critylla authorises her own complaint and credits the incense-selling speaker’s separately approved reply, with the herald and festival chorus.
choices.textTemplate: Critylla authorises her own complaint and credits the incense-selling speaker’s separately approved reply, with the herald and festival chorus.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-thesmophoria-mica

choices.textTemplate: {actor} brings the garland to Mica after hearing the words each woman chose to share. The approved replies keep their named speakers.

choices.textTemplate: {actor} delivers Agathon’s loaned robe to Mnesilochus. He answers for the case he serves in this festival comedy.

choices.textTemplate: Mnesilochus agrees to travel with {actor} through the festival and guarded stage. His later Agora exit awaits the recorded release terms.

choices.subject: greek-comedy-thesmophoria-mnesilochus

choices.textTemplate: Mnesilochus arrives at the festival in the agreed route. {actor} records his own answer about the borrowed dress.

works.author: Aeschylus
works.title: Persians
works.premise: A messenger's account of defeat must reach the grieving court without losing its source.

source.author: Aeschylus
source.adaptation: The separate historical Salamis frame carries an actual broken oar, named loss roll, offering water and cloak. The messenger’s named dead are Artembares, Dadaces and Tenagon. Darius’s warning places Plataea in the future. The chosen audience follows Xerxes’s actual cloak custody and court journey. The private alternative also requires Atossa’s actual arrival and records a later family disclosure duty. Public mourning adapts the source’s final lament; private consolation and civic reckoning are original alternatives. The actual signed roll reaches Dione through a carrier who heard the chosen court account.

source.author: Aeschylus
